text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A for gains felt rewarding, but taking profits alone did not prevent my account from shrinking; I need a plan for both winners and the risks in my remaining holdings.","I waited until Stocks B, E, D, and C had fallen sharply before selling. I should set review and risk limits in advance, rather than let loss aversion delay decisions.","My average cost is not a reason to keep or sell a stock. I should judge each holding by its prospects and its role in my portfolio, while keeping position sizes manageable."]}
